environment.description: Same service deployed behind an Envoy sidecar proxy (Istio 1.19 mesh) with a custom Lua filter on the inbound listener chain that applies RFC 5424 structured-data escaping to all query parameters before forwarding to the application. The Envoy filter replaces CR (0x0D), LF (0x0A), and escape sequences in parameter values with their percent-encoded equivalents, and truncates any single parameter value exceeding 256 bytes. Additionally, the Logstash pipeline on the collector side has a mutate filter with gsub that strips any remaining ANSI escape sequences and HTML tags from all indexed fields before Kibana rendering. The CDN-served scripts use SRI with sha384 hashes verified by a service mesh egress gateway that performs response body hash validation independently of the browser—the Envoy egress filter computes SHA-384 of response bodies for configured CDN origins and resets the connection if the hash doesn't match the pinned values in a ConfigMap, preventing any MITM script tampering regardless of browser SRI support.

config.envoy_inbound_lua_filter: gsub on query params: CR/LF/ESC -> percent-encoded, max 256 bytes per param
config.envoy_egress_filter: SHA-384 body hash validation for cdn.monitoring.internal/* responses against pinned hashes in ConfigMap sri-pins
